Definition
[$C^{m,\alpha }$ norm at scale $r$]

Source: petersen:page-0426, petersen:page-0427 ↗ def:pet-ch11-holder-space Define $\| (M,g,p)\| _{C^{m,\alpha },r}\le Q$ when a $C^{m+1,\alpha }$ chart exists from $\varphi :(B(0,r),0)\subset \mathbb {R}^n\to (U,p)\subset M$ such that \begin{equation} \begin{aligned} \text{(n1)}\quad & |D\varphi |\le e^Q\text{ on }B(0,r),\\ & |D\varphi ^{-1}|\le e^Q\text{ on }U,\\ & e^{-2Q}\delta _{kl}v^kv^l\le g_{kl}v^kv^l,\\ & g_{kl}v^kv^l\le e^{2Q}\delta _{kl}v^kv^l,\\ & v\in \mathbb {R}^n. \end{aligned} \end{equation} \begin{equation} \begin{aligned} \text{(n2)}\quad & r^{|I|+\alpha }\| \partial ^Ig_{ij}\| _\alpha \le Q\\ & \text{for every multi-index }I,\\ & 0\le |I|\le m. \end{aligned} \end{equation}
